name: AuthenticatedScripts
description: Use a service connection with scripts instead of pasting secrets into variables!
helpMarkDown:
For script modes, the Generic service connection is exposed as `AS_SC_URL`, `AS_SC_USERNAME`, and `AS_SC_PASSWORD`. 

In `createVariables` mode, the task creates job variables `${variablePrefix}_URL`, `${variablePrefix}_USERNAME`, and `${variablePrefix}_PASSWORD`; the username and password variables are secret.
author: Authenticated Scripts contributors

inputs.name: serviceConnection
inputs.label: Service connection
inputs.helpMarkDown: The Generic service connection to use for the authenticated script.

options.bash: Bash script - Linux and macOS only

inputs.name: scriptFile
inputs.label: Script file
inputs.helpMarkDown: Script file to run with the configured shell. Required when Script location is Script path.

inputs.name: inlineScript
inputs.label: Inline script
inputs.helpMarkDown: Script to run with the configured shell. Required when Script location is Inline script.

inputs.name: parameters
inputs.label: Parameters
inputs.helpMarkDown: The parameters passed to the script file.

inputs.name: variablePrefix
inputs.label: Variable prefix
inputs.helpMarkDown: The prefix for the pipeline variables created by the script. Required when Script location is Create pipeline variables.

inputs.name: pwsh
inputs.label: pwsh YAML shorthand

inputs.name: powershell
